description:
Windows tray app for viewing local Codex usage limits.

A small, privacy-friendly Windows tray application that reads local Codex usage and task-state metadata. It displays weekly and rolling five-hour limits through widgets, a tray icon and a multi-display taskbar indicator without account credentials, analytics, or telemetry.
Reads notification-icon coordinates correctly on multi-monitor desktops, keeps display-change handling active after opening the widget, shows hover widgets without stealing focus, and safely ignores malformed activity events. Includes the taskbar visibility and recovery fixes from 0.6.5.
